text:
The little lame girl is pregnant.

She moves with difficulty,

but how sweet the look

with which she faces you.


Her eyes grew wider

as though her child

were growing in them too,

small and clean.

Sometimes she stops to look

at who knows what,

and her white eyes

turn pink.


She walks among all the people

with difficulty.

She cannot hide it,

but on the verge of tears,

the little lame girl suddenly

looks at her belly

and laughs. And the people laugh.


The pregnant little lame girl

is on her balcony right now

and I think she cheers herself

by singing herself a song:

“little lame girl in the right foot

and in the heart as well.”

translation.title: The Little Lame Girl Is Pregnant
